disclosures.title: Global customer base limits geographic credit concentration
disclosures.body_text: Aramco states that its trade receivables arise from a global customer base, limiting geographic concentration of credit risk. It controls counterparty exposure through credit limits, financial-standing reviews, letters of credit, bank guarantees and parent-company guarantees. The report does not disclose a major-customer amount or percentage.
